newsitem.title: USA: Andrew falls on lower-than-expected sales.
newsitem.headline: Andrew falls on lower-than-expected sales.

text.p: Andrew Corp's share price tumbled more than 22 percent Thursday morning after the company reported second quarter revenues that fell short of market expectations.
"Second quarter earnings met estimates, but...there was a significant shortfall in sales," analyst Theodore Moreau of Robert W. Baird and Co said.

Andrew, which provides transmission lines, specialized antennas and other electronics products, reported second quarter earnings of $0.28 a share, up from $0.20 a year earlier. Analysts' consensus estimate was $0.28 a share, according to First Call.

Analysts said Andrew's $208.2 million in sales in the quarter, ended March 31, reflected an increase far short of what the market had expected. A year earlier the company had sales of $183.16 million.
"There was a little under 14 percent revenue growth, and the last two quarters were at 30 percent," Moreau said. "We were looking for 25 to 30 (percent)."
Analysts also said the second quarter revenues were lower than the first quarter's $231.66 million.
